s-1.ptxt: Install CVT Type T Oil Seal NO.2

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a hammer, install a new oil seal No.2.

atten3.ptxt: Do not install the oil seal facing the wrong direction.

s2.ptxt: Apply MP grease No.2 to the lip of the oil seal No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Shaft Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Apply CVT fluid TC to the spline of the inboard joint assembly LH.
Face the snap ring opening downward.
Align the splines of the drive shaft and transaxle, and insert the drive shaft assembly LH using a brass bar and hammer.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the oil seal.
Do not damage the drive shaft boot.

atten4.ptxt: Determine that the drive shaft is fully driven in by a change in the reaction force of the brass bar or a change in the sound.

s2.ptxt: Push the front axle assembly LH toward the outside of the vehicle, align the splines of the front drive shaft assembly LH with the front axle assembly LH, and insert it.

item.ptxt: Do not push the front axle assembly LH out farther than necessary.
Do not damage the oil seal.
Do not damage the boot of the front drive shaft assembly LH.
Do not damage the speed sensor rotor.
Check that there is no foreign matter on the speed sensor rotor or insertion part.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Push down the front suspension lower arm No.1 LH, install the front lower ball joint LH, and tighten it with the 1 bolts and 2 nuts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Stabilizer Link Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the front stabilizer link assembly LH to the shock absorber w/ coil spring with the nut.

atten3.ptxt: Using hexagon wrench 6, hold the stud bolt so that it does not spin.

s-1.ptxt: Install Tie Rod End Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Connect the tie rod end LH to the steering knuckle and install it with the castle nut.

atten3.ptxt: After tightening the castle nut, align the cotter pin hole by further tightening the nut within 60°.

s2.ptxt: Install a new cotter pin.
Install the flexible hose bracket and speed sensor harness bracket at part A to the absorber bracket with the bolt.

atten3.ptxt: Install the flexible hose bracket first, then install the speed sensor harness bracket.

s2.ptxt: Install the flexible hose bracket at part B to the steering knuckle with the bolt.
Install the speed sensor FR LH to the steering knuckle with the bolt.

item.ptxt: When installing the speed sensor body, do not damage the tip of the speed sensor.
Do not allow foreign matter to get caught.
Do not twist the sensor wire when installing.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Shaft Nut LH

s2.ptxt: Using a chisel and hammer, stake the front axle hub nut LH.

s-1.ptxt: CVT Fluid Refilling, Inspection and Adjustment

s2.ptxt: Vehicle Condition Check

item.ptxt: Perform the work after the fluid temperature has dropped to room temperature.
After stopping the engine, leave the vehicle for a long time (overnight).

s2.ptxt: Work Content Check

s3.ptxt: Refer to the work flow below and follow the procedure.

s2.ptxt: Add Fluid [*1]

s3.ptxt: Keeping the vehicle level, lift it up.
Remove engine under cover No.1.
Remove the engine under cover rear LH.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 6, remove the overflow plug.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 6, check that the overflow tube is tightened to the specified torque.

atten3.ptxt: If the overflow tube is not tightened to the specified torque, the fluid level will not be adjusted correctly.

s3.ptxt: Remove the refill plug.
Add fluid through the refill hole until fluid flows out of the overflow.

atten3.ptxt: Use CVT Fluid TC as the fluid to be added.

s3.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 6, temporarily tighten the overflow plug.
Add the specified amount of fluid through the refill hole.

entry.ptxt: Related Work
Refill Amount (Reference)
When the oil pan is removed/installed, when the drive shaft is removed and when an oil seal is replaced
When the torque converter assembly is removed and when K112F CVT oil seal No. 1 is replaced

atten3.ptxt: The refill amount varies depending on the related work.

s3.ptxt: Temporarily tighten the refill plug.
Lower the vehicle.

s2.ptxt: Add Fluid [*2]

s3.ptxt: Keeping the vehicle level, lift it up.
Remove engine under cover No.1.
Remove the engine under cover rear LH.
Remove the refill plug.
Add the specified amount of fluid through the refill hole.

entry.ptxt: Related Work
Refill Amount (Reference)
When the oil cooler and cooler hoses have been removed
When oil seepage, etc. has been repaired
When the transaxle assembly has been replaced (new torque converter assembly used)
When the transaxle assembly has been replaced (torque converter assembly reused)

atten3.ptxt: Use CVT Fluid TC as the fluid to be added.

s3.ptxt: Temporarily tighten the refill plug.
Lower the vehicle.

s2.ptxt: Switching to Oil Temperature Detection Mode (with TC Terminal Shorted) [*3]

s3.ptxt: Turn IG ON.
Turn OFF the switches for the air conditioning, audio system, etc.
Turn IG OFF.
Using SST, connect terminals 13 (TC) and 4 (CG) of DLC3.
Start the engine.
Slowly move the shift lever from P to D, then shift it back to P.
Switch to oil temperature detection mode.

entry.ptxt: Oil Temperature Detection Mode Switching Procedure
Perform the N - D operation within 1.5 seconds
Perform the above operation continuously for 6 seconds or more

s3.ptxt: The meter indicator light [D] illuminates for 2 seconds and then goes off.
Depending on the fluid temperature, the meter indicator light comes on, goes off or blinks.

item.ptxt: Add fluid while the meter indicator light is illuminated.
If the meter indicator light is off, perform fluid temperature adjustment [*4] to adjust the fluid temperature to between 30°C and 40°C.
If the meter indicator light is blinking, check the vehicle condition and wait for the fluid temperature to drop before performing the work.

s2.ptxt: Fluid Temperature Adjustment (with TC Terminal Shorted) [*4]

s3.ptxt: Move the shift lever to P.
Disconnect terminals 13 (TC) and 4 (CG) of DLC3.

item.ptxt: Be sure to open terminal TC, as the fluid level cannot be adjusted accurately unless it is open.
If the TC terminal is not disconnected, the oil temperature may quickly exceed the adjustable temperature range.

s3.ptxt: To raise the CVT fluid temperature, warm up the engine at idle.
As soon as the meter indicator light [D] illuminates, lift up the vehicle.

atten3.ptxt: Adjust the fluid level while the meter indicator light is illuminated.

s2.ptxt: Switching to Oil Temperature Detection Mode (Using SST (TaSCAN)) [*5]

s3.ptxt: Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Start the engine with the switches for the air conditioning, audio system, etc. turned OFF.
Select the Active Test (TC terminal ON), and with the A/T oil temperature displayed, turn the TC terminal ON.
Slowly move the shift lever from P to D, then shift it back to P.
Switch to oil temperature detection mode.

entry.ptxt: Oil Temperature Detection Mode Switching Procedure
Perform the N - D operation within 1.5 seconds
Perform the above operation continuously for 6 seconds or more

s3.ptxt: The meter indicator light [D] illuminates for 2 seconds and then goes off.
Depending on the fluid temperature, the meter indicator light comes on, goes off or blinks.

item.ptxt: Add fluid while the meter indicator light is illuminated.
If the meter indicator light is off, perform fluid temperature adjustment [*6] to adjust the fluid temperature to between 30°C and 40°C.
If the meter indicator light is blinking, check the vehicle condition and wait for the fluid temperature to drop before performing the work.

s2.ptxt: Fluid Temperature Adjustment (Using SST (TaSCAN)) [*6]

s3.ptxt: Move the shift lever to P.
Turn the TC terminal from ON to OFF.

item.ptxt: Be sure to open terminal TC, as the fluid level cannot be adjusted accurately unless it is open.
If the TC terminal is not disconnected, the oil temperature may quickly exceed the adjustable temperature range.

s3.ptxt: To raise the CVT fluid temperature, warm up the engine at idle.
As soon as the meter indicator light [D] illuminates, lift up the vehicle.

atten3.ptxt: Adjust the fluid level while the meter indicator light is illuminated.

s2.ptxt: Checking Fluid Level [*7]

atten4.ptxt: The fluid level adjustment method differs depending on whether or not the fluid overflows.

s3.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 6, remove the overflow plug.
Check the fluid condition.

item.ptxt: "Overflow" refers to the condition in which fluid flows out of the overflow tube.
If only a small amount of fluid flows out, it may just be the fluid that had collected in the overflow tube (approximately 5cc), so judge that it is not overflowing.

s3.ptxt: If it overflows, go to step [*8]
If it does not overflow, go to step [*9]

s2.ptxt: Adjusting Fluid Level (When Overflowing) [*8]

atten3.ptxt: The drained fluid is hot, so handle it with care.

s3.ptxt: When the fluid flow changes from a thin stream to drips, fully tighten the overflow plug with a new gasket.
Fully tighten the refill plug with a new gasket.
Install the engine under cover rear LH.
Install the engine under cover No.1.
Lower the vehicle.
Turn IG OFF and disconnect SST (TaSCAN).

s2.ptxt: Refilling Fluid (When Not Overflowing) [*9]

s3.ptxt: Remove the refill plug.
Add fluid through the refill hole until fluid flows out of the overflow.

atten3.ptxt: Use CVT Fluid TC as the fluid to be added.
Adjust the fluid level while the meter indicator light is on.

s3.ptxt: When the fluid flow changes from a thin stream to drips, fully tighten the overflow plug with a new gasket.
Fully tighten the refill plug with a new gasket.
Install the engine under cover rear LH.
Install engine under cover No.1.
Lower the vehicle.
Turn IG OFF and disconnect SST (TaSCAN).

s-1.ptxt: Install Engine Under Cover Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Install the engine under cover rear LH with the 5 clips.
Install the engine under cover No.1 with the 6 bolts and 7 clips.
